card.name: Space after a word, before a noun
card.fires_on: The space token in running web prose, right after a determiner, adjective or preposition (the, added, in, shallow, a). A content noun usually follows.

modes.label: After the or an adjective
modes.description: The space comes after a determiner or modifier and a noun is expected next.
modes.example: But the<< >>amount of BPA and phthalates

modes.label: After a preposition or verb
modes.description: The space comes after a preposition or verb in general prose, before a noun or adjective.
modes.example: remain the leading power in<< >>space: “In fact we may be

modes.label: Code or technical comparison
modes.description: The space comes after "a" in a technical explanation, before a noun phrase.
modes.example: is syntactic sugar for a<< >>*different* method call.

card.plain: It fires on the blank space between a small word and the noun that follows, in ordinary web articles.
